Listen to Madan Mohan Danish's shayari at the 5th 2018.
Jashn-e-Rekhta
The Jashn-e-Rekhta is an annual three-day festival celebrating Urdu language, literature and culture. Held every year in New Delhi, this festival is free for all and aims to bring together people from different backgrounds, communities and beliefs as well as those who share a love for Urdu.
